components.ownership: Borrow all inputs for the duration of a call. Allocate nothing. Write outputs on success.

operations.behavior: Sample a named curve on normalized progress.
Sample a delayed scalar tween at explicit elapsed microseconds.
Sample ordered scalar keyframes with segment easing.

components.ownership: Caller owns and serializes each playback object. The SDK retains no pointer.

Read elapsed playback time without mutation.
Freeze elapsed time at the supplied timestamp.
Resume paused playback at the supplied timestamp.

components.ownership: A mount owns its descriptor table. The caller owns the graph. Each graph owns its topology and borrows compute contexts. Tree destruction detaches graphs.

operations.behavior: Copy a unique, typed descriptor table onto an existing custom mount.
Read the typed current value on a live mount.
Prepare and commit one validated property update.
Copy an acyclic typed graph with live property endpoints and unique targets.
Evaluate, prepare and atomically apply one set of typed input values.

components.ownership: Rules borrow arrays and callback contexts for the invocation. The tree copies intent fields and their text and exposes borrowed FIFO views.

operations.behavior: Match the routed event and phase, evaluate typed properties and predicates, and stage one derived intent per allowed rule.
Copy already computed typed fields into one callback-scoped intent.
Borrow the first committed byte or typed intent from the tree FIFO.

components.ownership: The tree owns queued assignment lists and text. A live subscription borrows its receiver context. Removal retires work for affected mount generations before disposal.

operations.behavior: Validate and commit an entire explicit property assignment list.
Copy a mount-scoped property batch with an explicit deadline.
Attempt due batches in stable deadline order up to the caller's budget.
Register one receiver for an intent kind scoped to a live mount.
Consume a bounded number of intents and deliver each once to matching subscriptions.
Retire one live tree-local batch or subscription ID.

components.ownership: The snapshot owns copied versioned bytes. The caller owns persistence, the destination mapping and the snapshot lifetime.

operations.behavior: Capture explicitly selected writable properties into an owned snapshot.
Validate and copy exact supported snapshot bytes.
Atomically restore a snapshot onto the caller's ordered destination properties.

components.ownership: A sheet owns its rule data and text. Resolution borrows the ordered sheets, paths, and region spans.

operations.behavior: Validate and copy typed selector rules into an immutable sheet.
Choose a property declaration by override tier, specificity and declaration order.
Resolve and commit matching typed properties together on live mounts.
Overlay resolved color channels on a logical text layout using the mounted owner.

components.ownership: Pure geometry borrows its inputs. Mounted charts own their dataset, sector weights and configuration. The caller supplies time and publication.

operations.behavior: Map an inclusive data point to continuous cell coordinates with optional equal physical units.
Return a visible directed segment within the inclusive data box.
Mount signed bars, sectors, scatter, polylines or paired edges with copied data.
Replace a chart's authored data and render policy atomically.

components.ownership: The mount owns its value and style. The integer value and colors can be written as typed properties.

operations.behavior: Mount seven-segment signed fixed-point digits with an optional decimal point.
Replace the numeric display's value, precision and style.

components.ownership: Layout snapshots own sorted node and edge records. A mount owns its layout and UTF-8 labels, and the last published frame owns its semantic hit map.

operations.behavior: Copy records and place nodes using layered, radial or bounded force layout with explicit pins.
Mount an owned graph and typed interactive selection in a terminal component tree.
Replace graph data and view policy atomically, retaining a surviving selection ID.
Resolve a visible node, label or directed or undirected edge to its stable ID.
Change or clear the current selection without emitting a user intent.
Decode kind and ID from a typed user selection intent.

components.ownership: The workspace owns its window mounts. Windows copy panel chrome and own their body subtrees. A provider's explicit disposer takes ownership only after a successful mount.

operations.behavior: Mount a workspace for bounded floating and docked windows.
Mount a panel that participates in workspace placement and input.
Set floating geometry, mode and docking policy for a live window.
Drive committed window layout from a caller-time rectangle animation.
Transfer focus into the published subtree and raise its window.
Mount caller-authored paint, optional updates and input in a panel-compatible leaf.

components.ownership: The mount owns its authored text, action records and expiry. Consumers own domain action handlers.

operations.behavior: Mount an expiring or persistent card with copied text and actions.
Atomically replace content, actions and lifetime and reject input against the prior configuration.
Dismiss a card through explicit application policy without emitting a user intent.
Read the notification identity and action from the typed intent queue.

components.ownership: Immutable emitters copy their configuration. The mount owns its view configuration and glyph. Analytic trail sampling keeps no retained history.

operations.behavior: Copy a bounded seeded emitter with explicit birth and lifetime rules.

Reconstruct a live particle's trail at bounded caller-authored offsets.
Paint clipped particles and trails through the caller's paint context.
Mount a timed particle leaf with copied appearance and explicit reduced motion.
Replace the emitter and view configuration without remounting.

Aggregate current contacts by cell with integer mass and channel means.
Sample deterministic release particles in stable identity order.
Compute the next representable hold, expiry or full-motion sampling time.

components.ownership: Recipe glyphs borrow static bytes. Effect emitters copy emitter and motion settings. Mounted effects also copy glyph bytes and own their deadlines.

Create an emitter with seeded angular motion, sway or stepped alpha.
Mount a timed particle effect with copied configuration.
Validate and replace the configuration of a mounted particle effect.

operations.behavior: Advance water, foam and thermal energy over explicit edges and report external changes.

operations.behavior: Relax two world velocities and publish conserved impulse and dissipated energy.

Publish a validated edit atomically and preserve identities of unchanged clusters outside the edit.
Read a stable identity and current source span in logical order.

operations.behavior: Classify presentation and intrinsic columns from Unicode 17.0.0 data.

Resolve a visual grid edge to a logical byte boundary and affinity.
Map a published logical caret and its affinity to a visual grid edge.

Resolve a palette index by premultiplied linear RGB and alpha distance.

Sample an indexed palette with step or eased linear filtering.
Evaluate a spatial pattern from explicit coordinates, rotation and phase.
Sample a solid, gradient or palette with optional time-varying phase and opacity.

Read effective mask coverage at a view-local cell.
Composite a background in covered physical cells and preserve complete glyphs.
Composite backgrounds independently and update glyphs only when affected footprints fit.

operations.behavior: Parse a supported encoded-sRGB blend mode by name.

Apply a blend and composite contributing colors with explicit alpha, mixing space and gamut policy.

operations.behavior: Paint styled logical spans using layout geometry and publish the clipped frame atomically.

operations.behavior: Copy ordered glyphs and independent background cells into an owned frame.
Sample a borrowed RGBA texture with explicit addressing and filter.
Resample authored image content and reduce tiles into an owned frame.

operations.behavior: Delegate a borrowed frame and explicit timestamp to a caller-owned sink.
